situation_headline: Insides Combo gains 2.6% in 26-week outlook; Flats decline 1.2%.
situation_paragraphs: Insides Combo trading at $505.43/cwt with +$0.04/cwt daily gain; Flats & Eyes at $499.76/cwt declining $0.26/cwt. Choice Beef Cutout up $0.45/cwt to $394.37/cwt. Pork Ham Knuckles command premium at $157.73/cwt; Pork Carcass Cutout at $96.77/cwt shows stable processing margin.

26-week forecast projects Insides Combo reaching $518.58/cwt (+2.6% from spot), signaling sustained manufacturing demand. Flats & Eyes expected to weaken to $493.88/cwt (-1.2%), indicating trim value compression. Divergent cut performance requires selective procurement positioning across product mix.

immediate: Lock 40% of Insides Combo volume at current $505.43/cwt; avoid exposure to flats spot weakness
Evaluate pork ham knuckle forward contracts—$157.73/cwt premium may not sustain beyond 4 weeks
Confirm Choice Beef Cutout supplier allocations given +$0.45/cwt momentum
Monitor daily insides pricing; set buy trigger at $503.50/cwt or lower
near_term: Secure 60-70% of 8-12 week Insides Combo needs via forward contracts targeting $510-515/cwt range
Establish hedges against Flats decline; consider alternative trim sourcing if -1.2% forecast holds
Negotiate pork carcass cutout volume discounts on 8-12 week commitments at $96.77/cwt baseline
Stress-test margin models assuming Insides at $518/cwt; identify labor/capacity constraints
